REJECT: web/src/html.ts detailScript poll-net broken end-to-end. (1) html.ts:505 tail() fetches /session/:id?since= which returns the full HTML page, then :507 JSON.parse(html) throws every 5s (and on every snapshot/summary SSE event) - the poll net and its snapshot-refetch never parse anything; docs/04 says ?since= narrows the page render but there is no JSON variant, so the client-side cursor net is dead code. (2) Even if it parsed, cursor vocabulary mismatch duplicates: client lastT is epoch-ms (sse.ts:39 log delta entry.t is a number; html.ts:494 lastT = number), request sends ?since=<epoch-ms-string>, server Date.parse(that) = NaN (snapshot.ts:64), and toLogViewEntries NaN-guard snapshot.ts:66 intentionally widens (Number.isNaN(floor) -> keep all). Proven: bun repro with numeric since returns all 6 lines instead of the 2 strictly newer. Net effect: every 5s poll appends the whole tail again -> unbounded DOM duplication on a long-lived page; log SSE deltas still work, so page looks fine briefly, then duplicates. Everything else verified PASS: bun test web 78/0, workspace 358/0, tsc clean; live boot port 0 in-memory ports: open flavor (log via port LINK not embedded, phaseHistory timeline, tool bars ok/err dots, send box POST /api/send, hue CSS-var only, esc incl. script-close breakout), server-side ?since= strictly-newer filter, archived flavor (ARCHIVED badge, closedAt/By, final summary pinned above log div, resolutions, no send box/no EventSource), POST send closed1 -> 409 session closed via existing errorJson denied mapping, archive index month-grouped, /archive/ghost 404, /archive/closed1 archived, /session/ghost 404 lists open, agent page empty state + watcher card (digest/counts/link) + unknown agentSurface id generic card 200 + pending id no-file degrade 200. Deltas session-scoped (d.sessionId === id gate). Fix direction: client poll needs a JSON endpoint (e.g. /api/session/:id/entries?since= reusing toLogViewEntries) or drop the poll net; normalize the since cursor (accept epoch-ms number-string: if it is all digits use Number, else Date.parse).

fix-round worker: poll-net double-bug fixed, commit 94b864e. (1) New JSON poll endpoint GET /api/session/:id/log?since= returning {entries:[LogViewEntry,...]} strictly newer than the cursor — reuses toLogViewEntries (bounded 400-line tail + cursor) over the injected logs port; client 5s poll now targets it (html.ts detailScript), never the HTML page. (2) parseSince: epoch-ms number-strings and UTC strings parse to an epoch-ms floor, compared NUMERICALLY against LogViewEntry.t — same unit as the log SSE delta entry.t (no unit drift); invalid cursor rejected with 400 on both HTML and JSON routes (explicit error over silent widen/empty — noted choice), empty-set fallback in toLogViewEntries as defense in depth. Tests: new web/src/log-poll.test.ts (parseSince vocabulary, strictly-newer filtering incl. epoch-ms cursor, live HTTP JSON shape / 400 / 405 / unknown-session empty / POST 405; validator repro pinned: epoch-ms cursor over HTTP returns only strictly-newer lines, was all-6 pre-fix) + detail-page client-script test pins the JSON route; new tests verified FAILING on pre-fix code (epoch-ms cursor widened 5/5 pre-fix vs 3 expected).
